verdict.rationale: Klaviyo offers a full REST API with private-key/OAuth auth, server-side SDKs (Python, PHP, Ruby, Node), and API-based campaign/flow creation, which supports headless/CI-style automation. However, there is no evidence of an official CLI, CI/CD templates, or documented headless test-runner integration built for automation pipelines. missing for 10: official CLI tool, CI/CD pipeline examples or GitHub Actions integration, documented automated testing/headless workflow beyond generic sandbox account testing.
